documents.text: In a dataset containing extreme outliers, the median is often preferred to the mean because its value is less affected by extreme observations. It describes the middle ordered value.

For a short gap in an ordered time series, linear interpolation can estimate a missing value from its neighboring observed values. Before using interpolation, inspect whether the gap is short enough and whether the series changes smoothly.
